246062603_b8ebd663.text: neurohypophyseal peptides may represent a single integrative neuromodulatory system, yet both peptides subserve sexually dimorphic functions at the behavioral level

246062603_8dd034e9.text: Sex differences in the central circuitry of the oxytocin and vasopressin systems may underlie sex-variant behaviors, but it is currently unknown whether the synaptic inputs or outputs of each neuropeptidergic system vary across males and females

246062603_f57fcfc2.text: We observed that both oxytocinergic and vasopressinergic neurons share highly similar synaptic inputs that are sex-conserved. Projection patterns differed across systems and showed sex differences, more pronounced in the vasopressin neurons.
